title: Infant Formula Sample Preparation for Element Analysis Using PIXE/RBS
author: Seth H. Frisbie
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.5qxg5xn
materials: Immediately before using, vortex the solution again.

steps.title: Prepare Powder Sample
steps.instruction: Work under a clean atmosphere to avoid dust contamination and transfer the powdered product to a laboratory-grade plastic centrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Use a disposable plastic spatula to deliver between 1.0000 g and 1.0099 g of powdered product into the tube.

steps.title: Dissolve Sample
steps.instruction: Create a solution or suspension of the powder using ultra-trace elemental analysis grade water.

substeps.instruction: Vortex until the powder is completely dissolved or forms a uniform suspension.

steps.title: Initial Sample Deposition
steps.instruction: Deposit the sample onto a labeled PIXE/RBS sample holder.

substeps.instruction: Vortex the solution immediately before filling the pipette tip.
Deliver 1.0 µL of the solution or suspension using an air displacement pipet onto the holder.
Repeat this process until three different drops from the same sample are placed in three different locations on the same holder, using a different pipette tip for each drop.

steps.title: First Drying Cycle
steps.instruction: Dry the initial drops at room temperature in a laminar flow hood for 24 hours.

steps.title: Layer Sample for Sensitivity
steps.instruction: Increase the quantity of matter on each spot by superimposing additional drops.

substeps.instruction: Vortex the solution immediately before filling the pipette tip.
Superimpose another 1.0 µL of solution or suspension onto each dried drop using a different pipette tip for each drop.

steps.title: Subsequent Drying and Layering
steps.instruction: Repeat the drying and layering process until each spot on the sample holder consists of three superimposed drops of 1.0 µL.

substeps.instruction: Dry samples at room temperature in a laminar flow hood for 24 hours after each layering step.

steps.title: Store Samples and Solutions
steps.instruction: Preserve the prepared samples and remaining solutions until analysis.

substeps.instruction: Store the sample holders with dried spots in a desiccator, protected from dust.
Store the remaining solution or suspension at 4°C (maximum 24 hours).
